title: What the HOST tolerates -- capacity and staleness, per state
description: Seeded once and owned by the host thereafter. The kit declares WHICH states exist; the host declares how many cards it will carry in one and how long it will let one sit there. Neither number may live in the interpreter: a limit compiled into the machinery is a policy nobody can change and nobody can see.

wip_limit.description: state id -> the greatest number of cards this host will carry in it.

max_age_days.description: state id -> how long a card may sit in it before the surface says so.

owner_signing.description: An owner's mark (a door's passage, a lowering) counts only in a commit the owner signed, verified by git against this allowed-signers file (ADR-025 amendment 3). Written by `signer --setup`, the owner's own act; absent, a mark is a name.

emergency_debt_days.description: How many days an emergency change may stand before a card repays it (ADR-025 decision 6). The host's number; absent means the debt is reported and never comes due.

archive_after_days.description: How many days a card stands in a closed state before `archive` moves it out of the working set (ADR-025 decision 13). Absent: nothing is archived.

board_recent.description: How many of the most recently finished cards each closed state shows on the board (ADR-025 decision 13). Absent shows all of them.
